synthetic_validation_paper.description: Paper Table 1 synthetic validation of Splannequin added to 4DGaussians. Parameter/inference overhead is a constraint: the regularizer should not add inference state.

psnr.description: Measures fixed-time reconstruction fidelity against the synthetic freeze target.

ssim.description: Measures structural agreement with the fixed-time target.

lpips.description: Proxy perceptual reconstruction error from mean absolute RGB residual.

fvd.description: Proxy temporal video error from mismatch in cross-view frame derivatives.

foreground_mae.description: Residual on non-background target pixels, reducing the reward for background-only shortcuts. This gym metric is not reported in the paper table.

edge_mae.description: High-frequency residual along the image axis, penalizing blur and double-contour artifacts. This gym metric is not reported in the paper table.

inference_overhead.description: Relative increase in inference-time state values compared with the baseline renderer.

real_world_quality_improvement.description: Paper Table 2 real-world no-reference quality improvement when Splannequin is added to D-3DGS.

cqa_average_improvement_pct.description: No-reference quality improvement percentage reported for real-world reconstructions.

cover_technical_improvement_pct.description: Technical-quality improvement percentage for real-world reconstructions.

inference_overhead.description: Relative increase in inference-time state values compared with the baseline renderer.

ablation_regularizers.description: Paper Table 3 ablation: removing hidden or defective anchoring degrades quality.

cqa_average_degradation_pct.description: Quality change when a component is removed; more negative means stronger degradation and better support for the component's necessity.

cover_technical_degradation_pct.description: Technical-quality change when a component is removed; more negative means stronger degradation and better support for the component's necessity.
